requirements: The tenant must be provisioned in a region that supports Edge Processors.
The Edge Processor service must be activated for the tenant.
Record the deployed Edge Processor instance version during qualification.
Enable the Data Management control plane and Edge Processor service.
The repository's installed Splunk baseline is Enterprise 10.6.0.5; Edge Processor itself is not installed in the local qualification lab.

input.format: structured HEC JSON event envelope; JSON Lines is one envelope per line
input.selected_endpoint_reason: Atlas inputs are JSON HEC event envelopes. Splunk documents /services/collector/raw for raw payloads and warns JSON data might not be transformed as expected there.
input.indexer_acknowledgement: disabled on HEC tokens used with the Edge Processor
input.event_body_contract: The structured HEC event object remains the event body. SPL2 changes only destination index metadata; runtime semantic preservation must be confirmed with product preview and indexed readback.

destinations.selected_destination: one Splunk platform index destination per pipeline; use the connected indexer S2S destination where available

pipelines.partition_scope_note: Configure this condition in the pipeline builder. Do not add it as a SPL2 where filter; unmatched data must remain eligible for the Edge default destination.
Configure this condition in the pipeline builder. Do not add it as a SPL2 where filter; unmatched data must remain eligible for the Edge default destination.
pipelines.operator_requirement: Set adm_index_o11y_health to index=atlas_o11y, or change this template target index and the macro together before activation.

behavior.masking_reason: The selected traffic tuple, ports, timestamps, sampling/counters, health identity, metric values, and completion evidence are all consumed by Atlas; no field in these selected contracts can be masked without reducing required evidence.
behavior.unmatched_input: A valid event outside all applied pipeline partitions is sent to the Edge Processor's configured default destination. If no default destination is configured, it is dropped.
behavior.pipeline_filtered_input: Dropped; these templates contain no filtering command.
behavior.malformed_hec_input: Not assigned a pipeline fallback by this profile. Validate HEC request rejection and source-side error counters on the selected Edge Processor version.
behavior.delivery_guarantee: No application-level delivery guarantee is claimed. Edge Processor persistent queues and destination counters must be monitored.

serialization.event_json_byte_order_preservation: unqualified; canonical fixture hashes cover JSON semantics only
serialization.duplicate_json_key_runtime_behavior: unqualified; the offline fixture validator rejects ambiguous duplicate keys
serialization.offline_null_contract: Every selected health metric fixture explicitly carries these nulls; the offline validator enforces key presence and JSON null values.
serialization.runtime_null_roundtrip: unqualified; verify explicit nulls in product preview and indexed readback before qualification.

scope_exclusions: All other sourcetypes outside the two selected partitions
excluded_input_handling: Route excluded sources directly or separately qualify the product-specific unmatched/default route before sending them through the same processor input.
